name: ocean-live-status
description: Public status page for Ocean Live at status.oceanlive.org: checks the site, the app server and mail every 5 minutes.

scripts.cf:build: npm run check && npm test && node scripts/fill-ids.mjs
scripts.cf:deploy: node scripts/fill-ids.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply ocean-live-status --remote && wrangler deploy
